items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...this was the Zulus with Nat Shilkrit... you remember him... [INTERVIEWEE] They should have played Sing On...

ctx.x: I went to one funeral, and the very first thing, this was the Zulus with Nat Shilkrit, you know the guy from New York, the composer and band leader, you remember him, Nathaniel Shilkrit? Yeah, yeah. I took him to one, and the very first tune they played, Bourbon Street Parade, the very first number, before they even picked the body out.

They should have played Sing On or something like that, Sing On, and I'll wait to hear a little of the violin or something like that, walking through the streets of the city, one of those things like that. When do they usually play Sing On? When would be the proper time?
